title: Reltio RDM Tenant Configuration
description: Schema for Reltio Reference Data Management tenant configuration files (RDM.*.reltio.json), as returned by GET {serviceUri}/configuration/{rdmTenantId}. RDM configurations vary per tenant and this schema is derived from a limited sample, so the recognized property set is a lower bound: additionalProperties is deliberately left open at every level so that a property absent from the sample but present in a real tenant does not produce a validation error on server-produced content.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for inline validation

label.description: Human-readable label for the RDM tenant

trackTranscodeErrors.description: Whether transcode errors are tracked for this tenant

lookupTypes.description: Lookup type definitions. Each uri is what L3 attribute lookupCode values reference.

sources.description: Source definitions available to this RDM tenant

enabled.description: Whether the lookup type is enabled

startDate.description: Effective start date (epoch millis, 0 when unset)

endDate.description: Effective end date (epoch millis, 0 when unset)

abbreviation.description: Short form used in the UI

canonicalValueProvider.description: Whether this source provides canonical values
